summary: Trio Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its independent contractor agreement with CFO Greg Overholtzer, increasing monthly compensation from $15,000 to $17,000 effective July 1, 2026. No other terms changed. This is a routine compensation adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are involved. There is no risk-arb angle; it is an ordinary operational filing.
